items.name: Vincenzo
items.description: The original white mouse hunter with two red spots.

items.name: Luna
items.description: A sleek black cat with golden eyes. Silent as the night.

items.name: Tigro
items.description: A fiery orange tabby who loves the chase.

items.name: Nuvola
items.description: A fluffy grey cloud of a cat with icy blue eyes.

items.name: Biscotto
items.description: A cream-colored cookie cat with chocolate spots.

items.name: Bubblegum
items.description: A bright pink legend with purple spots. Very rare!

items.name: Zoomies
items.description: Run 1.6x faster for 20 seconds. Press 1 during the hunt.

items.name: Double Kibbles
items.description: Every mouse gives 2x kibbles for 20 seconds. Press 2 during the hunt.

items.name: Triple Kibbles
items.description: Every mouse gives 3x kibbles for 20 seconds. Press 3 during the hunt.

items.name: Pepper Sneeze
items.description: 3 mighty sneezes. Press E: every mouse nearby is knocked out instantly!

items.name: Kibble Blaster
items.description: A toy blaster that zaps mice from far away. Comes with 10 pellets. Press F to fire.

items.name: Kibble Pellets
items.description: 10 glowing pellets for the Kibble Blaster.

items.name: Top Hat
items.description: Very fancy. Very gentlecat.

items.name: Party Hat
items.description: Every catch is a celebration!

items.name: Golden Crown
items.description: For the true king (or queen) of the house.

items.name: Wizard Beard
items.description: A long white beard full of ancient mouse-hunting wisdom.

items.name: Moustache
items.description: A curly black moustache. Magnifico!

items.name: Cool Shades
items.description: Too cool for the mice to handle.

items.name: Bow Tie
items.description: A smart blue bow tie for formal hunts.

items.name: Cozy Scarf
items.description: A warm striped scarf for the chilly attic.

items.name: Surprise Box
items.description: What's inside? Could be a cat, clothes, a weapon or a boost!
